{{Top|leg}}
The '''unity grid Mark I''' was a [[Droid shield|shielding module]] that created overlapping shield vectors and then unified them into a single shield. As a result, the absorption capacity of the shield was greatly increased.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
